title: New suppliers: verify, then pay the first invoice
task: Pay this week's first invoices of our two new suppliers, Lindqvist Tools AB (LT-2026-0117) and Okoro Metals Ltd (OKM-25-0042). Pay a supplier only once it is verified: its tax registration certificate and its bank confirmation letter are in and checked, and a person in purchasing confirms. Pay only to the supplier's account in our master data, each invoice once, at most 20,000 EUR in total this week, every payment approved by a person with a reason.

context.data: the two first invoices, the suppliers' registration (country, IBAN given at registration, contact) and the documents they send back
